title: ChroPack - Protein G
author: Alexandra Ehl
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.72nhqde
materials: Do you want to purify antibodies or sanitize your column? Please choose below.

steps.title: Connect column and initial wash
steps.instruction: Connect the Protein G column to the FPLC system, set the flow rate to 1 bed volume per minute, and wash the column with 5 bed volumes of deionized water (bed volume is indicated on the column). A dry column may be connected directly; air will be expelled through the bottom outlet.

steps.title: Equilibrate column
steps.instruction: Equilibrate the column with 5 to 10 bed volumes of wash buffer.

steps.title: Load sample onto column
steps.instruction: Adjust the sample to pH 5.6–8 and 150–300 mM NaCl (add 1/11 volume 10× PBS as a starting point). If yield is low, lower the pH with sodium acetate buffer. Remove particulates by centrifugation or 0.45 µm filtration. Load the sample onto the column; for slow or weak‑binding antibodies, collect the flow‑through and re‑apply it.

substeps.instruction: Adjust pH and NaCl (add 1/11 volume 10× PBS).
If needed, lower pH with sodium acetate buffer.
Centrifuge or filter sample through 0.45 µm filter.
Collect flow‑through and re‑apply if binding is weak.

steps.title: Wash column
steps.instruction: Wash the column with 10 to 20 bed volumes of wash buffer, retaining flow‑through and wash fractions for later analysis (e.g., SDS‑PAGE). If nonspecific hydrophobic or ionic interactions occur, include up to 1 % Tween‑20 and/or up to 0.5 M NaCl in the wash buffer.

steps.title: Elute bound protein
steps.instruction: Elute with 10 bed volumes of elution buffer, collecting fractions of 0.5 to 1 bed volume each.

steps.title: Neutralize eluate
steps.instruction: Add neutralization solution (1 M Tris‑HCl, pH 8.5) to the eluate at a ratio of 100 µL neutralization solution per 900 µL eluate.

steps.title: Post‑elution column wash
steps.instruction: Wash the column sequentially with 5 column volumes of elution buffer, then 5 column volumes of wash buffer, then 5 column volumes of water. Afterwards, wash with 5 column volumes of either 20 % ethanol or wash buffer containing 0.05 % (w/v) sodium azide. Close the top lid and bottom stopper, and store the column at room temperature or 4–8 °C.

steps.title: Re‑connect and flush column
steps.instruction: Reconnect the column to the FPLC system and flush sequentially with 5 bed volumes of water, then elution buffer, then wash buffer (without urea), maintaining a flow rate of 1 bed volume per minute.

steps.title: Sanitize column
steps.instruction: Flush the column with 5 bed volumes of sanitization solution, stop the pump, and let the column stand for 1 hour.

steps.title: Final wash and storage
steps.instruction: Flush the column with 5 bed volumes of wash buffer (PBS) containing 0.05 % (w/v) sodium azide, disconnect the column, close it, and store at 4 °C or at room temperature. Wait at least 12 hours before the next purification.
